title: Gradient of a Linear Form
prompt:
Find the gradient ∇f of the linear function:

    f(x) = -3*x1 - 3*x2 - 6*x3

Enter it as a column vector (one component per row).
hint: ∇(aᵀx) = a; one component per row, e.g. 2; -3
recap: For a linear function f(x) = aᵀx, the gradient is the constant vector ∇f = a — each partial ∂f/∂xⱼ is just aⱼ.
